svg.aria-label: HAI Scale M1, Mixed, human-leaning. Hand-written from 2020 to early 2025. Since then, AI coding tools have helped restore lost work and build new features, and I reviewed, tested and ran every change in production. The full history is in “How AI was (and wasn't) used” below. Provided as is, with no warranty.
